segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: The briefing of the fiscal year 2027 proposed expenditure program of the Office of the Presidential Advisor on Peace, Reconciliation and Unity is hereby called to order.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: At this juncture, the Chair recognized the Committee Secretary to acknowledge the resource persons present for today.

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Chair. Good afternoon. Good afternoon to our resource persons.

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: For the briefing on the proposed FY2027 Budget of the Office of the Presidential Advisor on Peace, Reconciliation, and Unity, or OPAPRU,

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: we'd like to acknowledge our resource persons.

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: From OPAPRU, we have Secretary Mel Senen Sarmiento, together with Undersecretary Wilben Mayor,

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: Undersecretary Noel Baraceros, Undersecretary Jeffer Mancol, Executive Director Mary Marjorie Martin-Chan,

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: Executive Director Susana Guadalupe Marquedia, Executive Director Andres Aguinaldo Jr.,

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: Director Basil Castaño, Director Jenny Claire Mordeno, Director Laila Halud, Director Jana Jill Gallardo,

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: Director Christina Lauren Umali, and Director Jay Anthony Peña.

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: We have also invited representatives from DBM and COA.

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
Committee Secretary
segments.text: For DBM, we have OIC Assistant Director Mary Rose Aguilar and Ms. Maricel Dizon.

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
segments.text: For COA, we have Mr. Ryan Jeric Balada and Mr. Romel Fabi.

segments.speaker: Committee Secretary
Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: First, the Chair would like to welcome everyone.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: I'd like to give my opening statement for today's deliberation.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: We will tackle the FY2027 Budget of the Office of the Presidential Advisor on Peace, Reconciliation, and Unity,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: and ensure that its allocation will be efficiently spent.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Through the proper delivery of its programs towards peace and national harmony.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: The agency's role is highly important in maintaining the government's integrity in honoring pacts and agreements, formulating strategic and comprehensive peace programs, and cultivating dialogues that lead to conflict resolutions and trust-building.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: As we take up the agency's budget, we also highlight the implementation of the agency's PAMANA program as its flagship initiative in delivering livelihood, education, and developmental support to conflict-affected areas and conflict-vulnerable communities.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Sa kasalukuyan, marami pang nangyayaring hidwaan sa loob at labas ng ating bansa. Marami tayong pagkakaiba, madalas, magkakasalungat ang ating paniniwala, pinanggagalingan, at paninhindigan.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Ngunit sa kabila ng lahat ng ito, iisang ating layunin sa pagdinig na ito na ang pambansang pondo ay magbibigay daan sa mapayapa, tapat, at nagkakaisang serbisyo.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Our national fiscal space may be limited, but we will do our best to sustain not just the country's prosperity, but also its peace and stability. Thank you very much.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: I now call on Secretary Mel Senen Sarmiento to deliver his opening statement and to present the 2027

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: National Expenditure Program of the Office of the Presidential Advisor on Peace, Reconciliation and Unity.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Secretary Mel, you now have the floor.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: Thank you, Your Honor. Napakaganda po ng nasabi niyo kanina. Kapayapaan po, napakalaga para po makamit natin ang ating hinahangad na mga economic and development goals.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: Malaking leksyon kung titignan po natin sa buong Asia ang nangyayari sa South Korea.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: For example, in the 50s, meron po silang internal conflict na nakapekto sa kanila.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: We were six times richer than South Korea per capita wise in the early 1950s.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: Tinulungan pa po natin sila. We contributed $2 million para sa kanilang reconstruction.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: But since then, they were able to focus on their economic and development growth.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: Ngayon po, kung titignan natin ng South Korea, napakalaga.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: Napakalaki na po ng kanilang narating.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: Ganon din po ang nangyayari sa Vietnam.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: Natapos po yung kaguluhan doon, April 30, 1975, they were able to focus on their economic and development growth.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: And nahabol na po tayo nila.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: Napakalaga po kung titignan natin ang ating posisyon.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: Palagi pong napekto ang pag may kaguluhan po sa ating bansa.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: Kaya tama po kayo, Your Honor, na napakalaga po ng kapayapaan sa ating bansa.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: With that, I would like to request Usec Wilben Mayor to present our budget.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: You now have the floor to present the budget.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: To the chairperson, Committee on Finance.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: Thank you for the opportunity and presenting the proposed budget of OPA proof for 2027.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: Shown in this screen is the outline of the presentation.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: In the 2026 State of the Nation Address,

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. affirmed the government's commitment

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: to fulfilling the signed peace agreement

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: peace must be demonstrated through actual implementation and completion.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: For OPA proof, this means accelerating remaining commitments

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: and working toward the substantial completion of all peace agreements by 2028.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: At the core of our proposal is the agency's expanded mandate.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: Under Executive Order No. 158, Series of 2021,

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: in advancing a just and lasting peace for the nation,

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: especially those in conflict-affected and vulnerable communities.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: The agency is guided by the Five-Point Peace Reconciliation and Unity Agenda,

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: as shown, which is the policy anchor of the different peace processes,

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: the PAMANA, and other peace-building programs.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: we have achieved an overall accomplishment of 71%

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: in the implementation of peace agreements.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: This indicates that while we have reached significant milestones,

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: there is still substantial work ahead

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: This remaining gap highlights the need to sustain momentum

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: and, more importantly, to accelerate implementation.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: not only to sustain ongoing initiatives,

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: but also to catch up on delayed deliverables.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: With Fiscal Year 2027 as the last full year of the current administration,

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: we must maximize this period to ensure a successful transition

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: The peace process with the Moro-Islamic Liberation Front, or MILF,

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: has achieved 67% overall accomplishment in implementing the signed peace agreement.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: 100% in the political track, highlighted by the conclusion of the first parliamentary elections,

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: with significant progress in security commitments,

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: including the deployment of Joint Peace and Security Teams, or JPSTs,

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: management of Small Arms and Light Weapons, or SALT-W,

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: and sustainment of the ceasefire and security mechanisms.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: The implementation of the peace process

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: with the Moro National Liberation Front, or MNLF,

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: Its political track has completed 70% of the commitments,

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: with only the establishment of the Bangsamoro Development Assistance Fund, or BIDAF,

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: and the Tripartite Implementation Monitoring Committee, or TMC, remaining.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: The MNLF transformation program is at 16% completion

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: Under the peace process with the

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: which includes the full decommissioning of the CBA-CPLA,

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: and the integration of its members

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: into the Armed Forces of the Philippines.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: Socioeconomic interventions have also been implemented in the majority of identified communities. The implementation of interventions and assistance under the healing and reconciliation and confidence-building components comprise the bulk of the remaining deliverables.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: For the peace process with the Revolucionary Partido ng Manggagawa Pilipinas, Revolutionary Proletarian Army Alex Boncayo Brigade, or RPMP-RPA-ABB, 85% of the commitments have been completed, including Kapatiran's disposition of arms and forces, community peace dividends, and social and economic reintegration programs.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: Key deliberables remain, including the continued development of

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: settlement sites and the organizational development of Kapatiran chapters.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: Pursuant to the Local Government Code and Executive Order No. 70, Series of 2018, OPAPRU supports provincial local government units in the local peace engagement and further capacitating them in the development of transformation programs which aim to mainstream CPP-NP-NDF surrenders into the society and enable them to

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: and their families to be resilient from the resurgence the CPP-NP-NDF influence.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: The program has accomplished 65% of its target provinces.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: Recapitulating the status of peace agreements, the implementation of peace agreements across the four peace tables have achieved the following percentage completion as shown with the RPMP-RPA-ABB.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: The peace process as early as September 30, 2026 has already achieved the target 85% completion.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: And by the end of the current year 2026, the targeted achievements would be 72% implemented commitments under the GPH-MILF peace process, 53% for the peace process with the MNLF, including its transformation program,

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: For our fiscal year 2025 financial performance, as of December 31, 2025.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: We have obligated 97% or 6.9 billion of the total 7.1 billion agency appropriations for fiscal year 2025.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: For fiscal year 2026 status of funds.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: We have utilized 73% or 6.1 billion pesos of the total 8.3 billion for 2026 agency appropriation.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: Of this amount, 4.6 billion pesos was obligated for Pomana infrastructure projects

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: while the remaining funds supported OPA-PRO regular and ongoing normalization and transformation programs.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: Anchored on the President's Directive for OPA-PRO to achieve substantial completion of the peace agreements,

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: our proposal highlights investing in peace, investing in continuous sustainable development.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: To accelerate the peace agreements implementation, we must pursue post-conflict reconstruction, rehabilitation, and development.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: Its implementation suffered significant delays in previous years,

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: due to the COVID-19 pandemic, governance, and political transitions, which have put us in a critical catch-up phase.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: Peace Care Year 2027 is a crucial year to fully fund and fast-track the normalization and transformation programs

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: as we work toward fulfilling the national governance commitment under the signed peace agreements by 2028.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: We must also scale up socioeconomic integrity.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: For foreign rebels or combatants, their families and communities,

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: to address the root causes of un-conflict, eliminate the triggers for recruitment,

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: and prevent the threats of renewed violence and rebellion.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: We are likewise advancing the localization of normalization and transformation implementation

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: to ensure that interventions are felt where they are needed most,

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: right on the ground, inside our communities,

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: Finally, while our proposed funding is substantial,

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: it remains insufficient to address the holistic requirements of sustaining peace across all target areas.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: We will continue to mobilize support from other government agencies,

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: as well as local and international development partners to bridge this gap.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: However, robust baseline funding for Fiscal Year 2027

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: from the national budget remains the critical catalyst for leveraging these resources.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: The budget requests are not mere expenditures,

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: they are urgent investments in securing a just, sustainable, and lasting peace.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: This presents an overview of OPApro's Fiscal Year 2027 budget proposal.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: Muna kasi hindi kami sigurado kung papapayag ng adjustment yung, ah...

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: September 25 po, nag-meeting kami sa Kuala Lumpur.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: Nagpapasalamat din po kami sa Malaysia sa kanilang pag-host, ah...

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: ng meeting ng, ah... MILF at ang GPH.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: At, ah... na-aprubahan po ito ng konting adjustment.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: Dito sa existing na socio-economic package na mas responsive.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: Yes, may mga kailangan pa po kami rito.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: Pero once nagawa po natin ito, mapapabilis po yung ating, ah...

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: sa, ah... phase four niya, hopefully by 2027.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: Doon nangailangan pa kami ng konting oras dito

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: sa pag-submit ng additional proposal ng aming, ah... opisina.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: In short, ah... 14,000 ang tinitignan natin left to decommission.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: And, ah... what I understand, ah...

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: part of the challenge is yung napangakong 1 million. Tama?

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Ah... pag 1 million of that 14 is, ah... lumalabas 14 billion.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Assuming that will be given to the combatants.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Ah... and then tinitignan ko doon sa budget ninyo.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Ah... although your budget grew, no?

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: majority of which pupunta sa, ah...

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Ah... 6 billion out of the 9 billion will go to the pamana program.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Sa, ah... educational assistance, housing, roads.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Roads is about 3.7 billion na eh. No?

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: No? So, in other words, in... in short, from what I'm reading here,

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: yung ah... budget pupunta dito sa pamana program.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Yung pamana program is meant naman to, ah... sustain the peace efforts on the ground.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Tama po ba? Ganyan ang direction ng pamana eh, no?

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Ah... para nga may development, para may economic activity, ah... and ah...

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: ma-sustain, no? In gains of peace.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Ang kulang dito sa budget ninyo is for that decommissioning.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Magkano ang naka-allocate for decommissioning in your 9 billion budget?

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: Um... this is something that, ah...

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: we, as of the moment, cannot really divulge, ah... the... the proposal

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: because it's a working process given that the approval on the part of the MILF, ah...

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: then somewhat concurring to the proposal was last September 25.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: If, ah... may... may... if the good chairperson will allow a 5-minute recess,

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: I can perhaps go... perhaps go there and brief you a little bit about it

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: so you'll have an idea of what, ah... the proposal is what's going to be.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: We'll do that, ah... later on, ah... chairman.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Ah... so, I know there are some sensitivities in the, ah... process.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: We'll... we'll, ah... have a short, ah... break later on.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: But our proposal is going to be very doable, ah...

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: Mr. Chair, we can assure you.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Ah, this is the... within the decommissioning.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: I can perhaps discuss this with you, ah... ah... after.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Um... with that, ah... ang itutuloy ko naman ang next question ko is the education.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Ah... I... I know that is a... ah... from what I understand, ah... yung mga... ah... beneficiaries nito, they're... they feel very strongly, ah... ah... dito sa educational assistance, no?

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So, may I know kung ano na ng... can I get an update for... on the additional 850 million that we included in the 2026 budget?

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: And, ah... yan talagang direk... direkta para sa educational assistance. May I get an update on the... on that, ah... portion?

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: For the information of everyone, no less than the Senate President helped us in securing this allotment amounting to 807,500,000 pesos.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: For the educational assistance program. Ah... thank you, Honorable Senate President.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: And out of this amount, it was distributed between the MILF and MNLF members.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: The amount for MILF is 605 million while for the MNLF is 202,500,000.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: But, ah... just to underscore, Your Honors, ah... considering that the DBM is also here, ah... saro pa lang po ang sa amin po.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: At wala pa po yung, ah... we're still awaiting for the notice of cash allotment dito po, ah... Your Honors.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So, Yusek, wala pang, nabigay na yung SARO?

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: We have already the names of the beneficiaries.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: And na-identify nyo na yung mga beneficiaries?

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: With that number of 16,500, meron na po kami mga list ng beneficiaries.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: But yet again, we are waiting for the notice of cash allotment.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: Same with the memorandum of agreement was already executed between the state universities

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: na kasama po doon sa mag-e-sponsor ng educational assistance program po ng OPAPRU

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: as well as yung ibang para po sa mga beneficiaries natin sa IMLH at IMLH.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: And then for 2027, nakita ko dito meron ding...

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
segments.text: Ang program po natin yan is yung four years po.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
OPAPRU Presidential Assistant Wilben M. Mayor
OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: Mr. Chairman, I hope you can join us one of these days with the beneficiaries.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: We are very thankful to the Senate, this august body, for providing that allocation.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: Meron po tayong 31 na partners na SUCs throughout the country.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: Nagsalita yung isang scholar po natin kasama yung mga kiilang mga anak ng mga...

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: Talagang pinigilan na lang naming-aming emosyon.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: Yung pondo pong binigay ninyo sa scholarship, nagbigay po ng pag-asa sa kanila.

segments.text: Sa pag-respeto sa proseso at pagpapasalamat sa ating mahal ng Pangulo na hindi makikialam sa pagpili ng kanilang leader dahil palagi po nating panindigan dito, ang hugot po ng BOL is self-determination and each one of us should respect that, allow them to choose their leaders.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: And they're very thankful to the national government for providing them the space for them to select their own leaders, for them to somewhat determine their future. They want a progressive Mindanao.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: In fact, for almost five years po nag-probo no community development work po ako sa BARM, helping 27 local government units.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: Ang battle cry po ngayon, tama.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: Sa Senator JB, chairperson po natin.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: Ang battle cry po ngayon sa Basilan, Basulta, Basilan, Sulu, Tawi-Tawi, kahit wala na po yung Sulu, hindi naman po natin pwedeng iwala yun, is from terrorism to tourism.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: Naka-focus talaga sila sa turismo ngayon.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: And in the Butig area, what used to be Abu Bakar, dinatawag natin Camp Abu Bakar, tawag po natin ngayon is Eranun Development Corridor.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: Kasama po dyan ang Parang, Matanog, Barira, and Buldon.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: Ang battle cry po nila sa area ngayon is from war zone to economic zone.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: I can provide you a copy of the video that was presented in Parang.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: Kasi ililipat po doon ang kanilang government center.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: Ang pangalan naman ng lugar is Moro Global Metropolis.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: Meron po silang Malaysian na mga investor who's going to develop.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: Ang biro ko po nga eh, kung matapos na yan, mukhang masarap tumira doon.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: I have a copy of the video.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: I can provide our senators present this afternoon a copy of it.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: At sa yung normalization process natin ngayon, ang focus po natin.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
segments.text: Pagkatapos po ng pagpili nila ng mga leader nila, tapos na po yung political trap.

segments.speaker: OPAPRU Secretary Mel Senen S. Sarmiento
